# Documentary source packet

## Interview, 2026-01-14

Leah remembers the neighborhood clinic opening "around 1998" after residents organized
for several winters. She is unsure whether the first meeting happened in the library or
the church basement.

## Municipal record

The occupancy permit is dated 2001-03-09. It does not identify who initiated the
project.

## Community newsletter, 1999-11

The newsletter asks residents to attend a clinic-planning meeting at the library. It
names six organizers and describes an earlier petition, but the petition is unavailable.

## Publication constraint

One living organizer consented to quotation. The other named organizers have not been
contacted.
